headline: Passage Reignites as Weathered Expanse Rages On
war_summary: Since the 09:22 edition the wires show Callahan's Passage stirring anew with two changes in the last two hours and 29 on the day to 12:27 about The Crumbling Passage and Scáth Passing, holdings standing nine Warden and one Colonial with day losses of 10,279 Colonial and 13,075 Warden and both casualty rates accelerating. Weathered Expanse remains the heaviest wire with six changes in two hours and 64 on the day to 11:56 about Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk, holdings five Warden and four Colonial with day losses of 8,794 Colonial and 14,382 Warden. Mooring County adds two changes in six hours and 14 on the day to 10:22 about The Wind Hills, The Cut and Wiccwalk, holdings eleven Warden and one Colonial. Stlican Shelf counts six changes in six hours and 24 on the day to 09:44 about Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost, holdings four Warden and five Colonial. Fisherman's Row and Nevish Line have gone quiet in the last two hours after 33 and five changes on the day to 07:44 and 07:34.
